title: Do not invent Documents file type or size restrictions
scope: Changes to the Documents registration HTTP presenter or RegisterDocumentUseCase input path that validate or reject an uploaded file by metadata, content, type, or size.
applies_when: The reviewed change adds or changes a condition that can reject a supplied Documents registration file before the current registration behavior executes.
violation: The change rejects a file because of its media type, extension, binary signature, or size while the canonical Register Document specification still defines no file type or size restriction.
non_violation: Requiring the file field to exist and exposing its binary content to the UseCase are not type or size restrictions; a changed approved specification must update or retire this rule before such restrictions become active.
evidence: Cite the rejecting validator or branch and the unchanged specification statement showing that the rejected type or size remains unrestricted.
